deviations: Primary hover/press uses opaque hover/pressed with normal text for reliable contrast, instead of translucent accent.
Fixed blue/white folder branding is unchanged across themes. Native shell menus and Windows dialogs retain OS-controlled colors.
Derived shadows/scrims use the reference alpha bytes through CSS composition.

Small warning/error labels use ContactSolutions icon_yellow/icon_red instead of orange/red. Its light orange on panel measures only 4.36:1; chosen palette tokens meet 4.5:1 for these labels. Disabled controls retain the reference disabled color and are not claimed to meet active-text contrast.
Static tray/overlay status assets use ContactSolutions dark icon colors and canvas outline for visibility across shell backgrounds.
Status labels use the reference surface instead of pill_quiet fill: icon_yellow on the light quiet pill is 4.18:1, below the active small-text target.
